gaps.GET /v1/discovery/entitlements/apps: lists the apps one SaaS entitlement source holds, each with its agent link state and the link transitions allowed next
gaps.PUT /v1/discovery/entitlements/apps/:app: links a vendor app to an agent by hand (a partial or fuzzy match), audited
gaps.DELETE /v1/discovery/entitlements/apps/:: unlinks a vendor app from its agent (auto or manual), audited; it is not auto-linked again
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/agent-identifiers: lists the vendor app identifiers declared for agents
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/agent-identifiers: declares an agent's app id on one platform; apps with exactly that id are auto-linked, each audited
gaps.DELETE /v1/discovery/agent-identifiers/:: removes a declared identifier (audited); existing links stay until an admin unlinks them
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/entitlements/findings: the SaaS entitlement findings (unused grant, excessive scope, oversharing, publicly exposed agent), computed at read time with their evidence and what is not assessable (ADR-0337 §5)
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/entitlements/findings: raises a SaaS entitlement finding the report flags now into the approvals queue for a second administrator's decision (remove the grant, or accept the risk); nothing executes
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/entitlements/findings/: lists raised finding reviews with their state and the transitions allowed next
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/entitlements/findings: withdraws a pending finding review (audited); its queue item is superseded
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/entitlements/sources/:: one entitlement source's guided read setup as data (#453): for Microsoft 365, the off-by-default activity-log setup, its exact admin steps and consent link, and the state the latest read observed; for Salesforce, what the default read sees and cannot see, and the org-wide token opt-in with its trade-off
